name: Bani
overview: Bani is a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Rehum, mentioned in Nehemiah 3:17. His tribal affiliation is not specified in Scripture. He is also named among those who sealed the covenant document in Nehemiah 10:14, indicating his participation in the communal commitment to God's law during the post-exilic period.
namesAndTitles: The name Bani is a proper name meaning "descendant." There is no indication that this name was given directly by God. The meaning simply reflects his identity as a member of the community recorded in the book of Nehemiah.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Bani as the father of Rehum, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family connections are provided in the biblical text beyond this relationship.
scriptureSignificance: Bani's significance lies in his role as a father of Rehum, who was involved in the rebuilding efforts in Jerusalem, as noted in Nehemiah 3:17. Furthermore, Bani's inclusion on the sealed covenant document in Nehemiah 10:14 underscores his participation in the collective renewal of the covenant among the returned exiles. This positions him as a faithful member of the community committed to restoring proper worship and adherence to God's commands.
